description:
A male god and a human woman both require the other to change into the forms they yearn for

But living together isn't as simple as it sounds when two beings are as opposite as night and day

The immortal and the mortal begin their lives together, often colliding despite needing the other

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H037426603), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/53582875), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4116000304), MeToon, [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H037426603), Tocsoda, Bookpal, [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000052942)

**Official English:**  
[Webcomics](https://webcomicsapp.com/comic/Mr-Psychic/621c90298c252b4c2a04fd5d), [Lalatoon](https://lalatoon.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/7096), [DAYcomics](https://daycomics.com/content/102934)
